name: @missing-elements/h5p-verify
description: Plays an .h5p package in a headless browser through h5p-offline-player and reports whether it works: start-up, errors, missing libraries, a screenshot. The last check before a generated package is handed to anyone.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!/^pnpm\//.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('Publish with pnpm publish: npm would ship the workspace:^ dependency ranges as they are, and the package would not install.'); process.exit(1) }" && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.types: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('types', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json
